Reference 1 is THE SAME TREE viewed from the front. Generate a completely new full image showing this identical tree rotated to the LEFT side (270 degree turn). Preserve its exact species, scale, trunk thickness, branching, crown volumes, palette, silhouette height and base placement. Rotate the whole coherent three-dimensional object, do not invent another tree, do not mirror the front. Keep camera and soft lighting fixed. Remaining references are only style/color references as explained below.

Tree design: A medium-sized pale flowering tree: broad rounded crown of substantial connected foliage lobes with large masses of soft ivory blossoms, subtle very pale blush accents and subdued green visible underneath; thick brown trunk. Flowers are painted colors on solid crown masses, NOT thousands of modeled individual flowers. Overall target height 700 pixels, crown width about 560 pixels.

Style references: the full colorful city and its two tree crops show ONLY the desired chunky rounded tree shapes and friendly softly hand-painted miniature style. Ignore every building, person, road, water and ground. The parchment map is ONLY a park-green harmony reference: use real muted greens compatible with its parks, slightly less saturated than the colorful source trees. NO sepia filter, no parchment on the object, no map or paper background. Broad coherent crown lobes with a little painterly color variation, economical subtle linework, thick trunk, not photorealistic, not a complex botanical model, not glossy plastic. Geometry should be readily simplified to about 1000 triangles: no thin branches, no individual loose leaves, no tiny holes or filigree.

Composition: square 1024x1024 pixel canvas. Orthographic camera at a fixed slight 10-degree downward elevation. Entire tree visible with generous clear margins. Trunk ground-contact is exactly x512,y920; target overall height as stated. Tree vertical, centered on x512, same camera scale and base position for every view. Tree trunk terminates cleanly at its bottom, no spreading roots outside the trunk. Do not auto-zoom to fill the canvas.

Backdrop: perfectly uniform solid opaque blue #7FB8DA to every edge and around the tree, for later masking. RGB image or fully opaque RGBA, NO transparency. NO floor, horizon, gradient, vignette, ground patch, base, pot, cast shadow or shadow under trunk. Soft diffuse studio lighting only on the tree; no dramatic lighting.

NO text, numbers, view labels, logos, dimensions, watermark, border, reference collage, other trees, grass, flowers on ground, buildings or props. Only the specified single tree against exact uniform blue. Preserve all supplied artwork; this is a completely new image, not a retouch of any reference.
FINAL VIEW-LOCK OVERRIDE: the canonical FRONT was actually generated on a 1254x1254 native canvas. Use this exact same 1254x1254 canvas and its camera scale instead of the earlier nominal 1024 specification. Match the front's actual top at y=220, trunk base at x=627,y=1120, total height about 901 pixels. Keep those fixed while turning the tree. Crown width may vary only as physically required by rotation. The output must unmistakably show the requested side, NOT repeat the front. Preserve colors and painted bark texture but make the entire blue background perfectly FLAT uniform solid #7FB8DA, no texture. No ground or cast shadow.
